verdict.rationale: Exa is a search/data API platform whose MCP integration runs in the opposite direction: it ships an MCP *server* so other AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code) can call Exa's search tools, not a client surface where a user plugs external MCP servers into Exa so Exa can use their tools. This story targets agent-like products that consume MCP servers, which doesn't apply to Exa's product category.
